spec.name: Furniture Carpenters Workbench
spec.description: A sturdy honey-oak workbench with a projecting wooden vise, lower storage shelf, hand plane, hammer and chisel. Warm worn edges, restrained iron accents and tidy tools give it a cozy survival-workshop character. Front faces negative Z; all geometry stays within the requested footprint.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: carpenters workbench with wooden vise and tidy hand tools. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
